comment: Prologue lines (GDD The first 10 minutes, 0:05–3:15): young Wan on the night of the hunt, 40 years ago. Every line is a bark: subtitled, never blocks control. BM is the source; EN is a natural translation, not word for word.

p.villager.1.speaker: villager
p.villager.1.bm: Wan! Harimau tu lari ke hilir!

p.wan.1.speaker: wan
p.wan.1.bm: Aku kejar ikut bumbung. Yang lain, jaga jeti!
p.wan.1.en: I'll take the rooftops. The rest of you, hold the jetty!

p.wan.after.speaker: wan
p.wan.after.en: Quick. The tracks are still fresh.

p.villager.2.speaker: villager
p.villager.2.bm: Air makin naik, Wan! Rumah-rumah dah runtuh!
p.villager.2.en: The water's rising, Wan! The houses are coming down!
